terra.problem: Saying that being in charge of the servants was never on the son's mind asserts a thought the text does not give.
Squandering does not establish how quickly the money went out or that nothing good came back.
The text says he squandered his wealth, but does not establish that he shared none of it.
The text calls the man a citizen of that country; it does not say he was a stranger to the son.
Calling grape picking a gentler job adds a comparison the text does not establish.
The text says no one would give him a thing, not that no one helped him in any way.
The passage says the father was filled with compassion, but does not say he had no doubt or was not wondering.
The father comes out to his son, but the text does not say he was at the party or left it.
The father's statement that all he has belongs to the older son does not establish that the son was never missing out on anything.
The servants have other roles in the story, and one servant, not the servants collectively, tells the older son what is happening.
